candidate.answerReason: Mr. A receives $8100 and then pays $8910 to regain the same house, leaving him with $810 less cash.

methods.label: Track the two sale prices
methods.explanation:
The two percentages use different price bases. Mr. A's \(10\%\) loss is based on \(\$9000\), so the first sale price is
\[
9000-0.10(9000)=8100.
\]
Mr. B's \(10\%\) gain is based on the \(\$8100\) he paid. He therefore sells the house back for
\[
8100+0.10(8100)=8910.
\]
Mr. A finishes with the same house he started with, but he has paid \(8910-8100=810\) dollars more than he received. Thus Mr. A loses \(\$810\), choice D.
